full.scope: One complete fresh captured torus4096 solve, including current domain refit, fresh sampling, all fitting/refinement/quality work, extraction and diagnostics. Setup and readback excluded from native profiling.

loop.scope: One graph launch with eight device-controlled producer/routed-Delaunay/consumer phases; includes full 4096-site reuse, smaller prefix, unrelated inputs, invalid count, nonfinite input and recovery. Setup, upload, final readback and independent checks are outside profiling.
